preamble: In the Moldavian dialect of Romanian, labials are palatalized before front vowels and the palatalized bilabial [pʲ] moves its primary closure to the palate, becoming the palatal stop [c] (spelled ch in dialect writing). The voiced [bʲ] and the nasal [mʲ] develop the same way, to [ɟ] and [ɲ].

examples.note: Initial p before a front vowel or glide becomes the palatal stop.

sources: Wikipedia contributors. Moldavian dialect: Phonetic features (labials p, b, m before front vowels become [c, ɟ, ɲ]). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moldavian_dialect
